acceptedRelationships.mechanism: The official CES payroll level is mapped without a coefficient to the employment-level state.
The official CPS U-3 rate is mapped without a coefficient to the unemployment-rate state.
The official CPS participation rate is mapped without a coefficient to the participation-rate state.
The official initial-claims level is mapped without a coefficient to a claims/separation signal; no causal claim is made.
The official JOLTS openings level is mapped without a coefficient to a labor-demand openings signal.
The official JOLTS hires level is mapped without a coefficient to the realized-hiring-flow state.
